name: Booking curve and pace
description: Spec §14.3, §14.6: the booking curve by club and night, and booking pace by days before the night.

parameters.name: Dataset
parameters.description: live = real clubs (analytics schema); demo = Velora only (analytics_demo schema)

cards.name: Booked share by snapshot
cards.sql: select * from (select club_id, night_date, taken_at, lead_bucket, tables_active, tables_confirmed, tables_arrived, pax_booked, booked_share from analytics.booking_curve where {{dataset}} = 'live' union all select club_id, night_date, taken_at, lead_bucket, tables_active, tables_confirmed, tables_arrived, pax_booked, booked_share from analytics_demo.booking_curve where {{dataset}} = 'demo') d where true [[and d.club_id = {{club}}]] order by club_id, night_date, taken_at

cards.name: Booking pace (cumulative confirmed bookings by days before)
cards.sql: select * from (select club_id, night_date, days_before, bookings, pax, cumulative_bookings from analytics.booking_pace where {{dataset}} = 'live' union all select club_id, night_date, days_before, bookings, pax, cumulative_bookings from analytics_demo.booking_pace where {{dataset}} = 'demo') d where true [[and d.club_id = {{club}}]] order by club_id, night_date, days_before desc
